text_block_list.text:
With the new year, Orfevre moved up to the 
Senior Class. Having achieved tremendous 
results last year, she was invited to a 
certain party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Orfevre-san, Journey-san. Over here!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Happy New Year to you too, 
Trainer.

Mejiro McQueen and Symboli Rudolf... They 
share a common trait. And that is—

The Mejiro family and the Symboli family. 
Both are prestigious houses that have left 
immense legacies in the racing world. 
Today is their joint New Year's party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your attendance. The 
gathered officials are delighted as well.
choice_data_list: No, thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do you still fail to grasp the hierarchy?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A dog is smarter.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...See, it must've been hectic getting 
ready to leave. Trainer, Orfevre still 
hasn't...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Slowpoke.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... How delightfully innocent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The "Emperor" and the King. I wonder which 
one is the child...

Mejiro Ramonu... The very first Triple 
Tiara Umamusume in history. A gifted lady 
who left behind monumental achievements 
for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What insolent eyes.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The tiara resting on your brow... seems to 
have lost quite a bit of its luster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Then perhaps I shall polish it. With 
a brand-new gold bar."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. It's a celebratory day. Both of 
you, please sheathe your blades.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Many race officials—including URA top 
executives—are gathered here today. They 
all said they'd love to hear from the new 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The stage has been prepared. Over that 
way――"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I have no need for it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Wherever I stand, that is the stage. 
—Shine the light upon me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Straighten up. I bring good news.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That which all people universally desire 
shall finally return to my kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall bring home the crown of the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe myself."

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Orfevre truly is destined for 
the world stage...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Sit and wait. ...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...How troublesome. It's over. Turn off 
the light."

Following Orfevre's declaration—or rather, 
proclamation—of her challenge to the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe, the gathered 
participants were all uniformly thrilled.

text_block_list.name: URA Representative
text_block_list.text:
With Orfevre-san's caliber, victory 
certainly isn't just a pipe dream...!

text_block_list.name: URA Representative
text_block_list.text:
Please, allow us to help as well! We will 
provide all the know-how we've cultivated 
so far!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Associate
text_block_list.text:
"We would be delighted to contribute as 
well! We possess expertise built all the 
way since the era of Speed Symboli, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it really warms my heart. New 
challenges keep rising, the level keeps 
climbing... and now, such marvelous 
Umamusume have emerged."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
To think I can still keep chasing my 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This year marks the end of me chasing 
after you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The next time I set foot on that land... 
...will be as the champion.

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: ...! I have high hopes for you!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Participating really was the right 
choice after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san. Thank you for reaching out to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Being able to contribute, even 
a little, to such excitement... As a 
representative of the Mejiro family, I 
take immense pride in it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, but... Come to think of it, when 
was it that I spoke to you?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well... I have completely forgotten as 
well.

After enjoying the party, we stopped by a 
shrine on a whim of Orfevre's, who wanted 
to take in the New Year's atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...It's no use. I can't wish for 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Getting stronger? Winning? ...Or maybe, 
making her weaker?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Looking at me? ...I don't understand...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Shion-san, Happy New Year.

To Win Variation, who clearly looked 
deeply troubled, Dream Journey called out 
in an easygoing tone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, Journey-sa—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Dost thou have business with this one, 
Sister? Then I shall proceed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Come, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it, someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...That outfit... Are you in the middle of 
training?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You'll be running in races again this 
year, correct? For someone of your 
caliber... your goal must surely be a GⅠ 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! ...I don't have any real talent. 
Compared to your sister, I'm... far 
inferior.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Do you dislike Or?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No, I don't hate... not at all...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You see, I love her very much. That girl 
is... my dream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I envy you. Because you are 
from the same generation, able to compete 
with her."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I envy you for being able to receive and 
feel her dazzling talent with your power 
at its peak."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
At the most primitive level, you have the 
chance to elevate that girl... What a 
wonderful potential you possess.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you don't need it, I'd gladly take it 
from you. ...No matter the cost.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wait, Journey...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, excuse me. I got sidetracked. What 
I meant to say was—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I know all too well the pain of looking 
up at an insurmountable wall. However... 
you possess both the aptitude and the 
talent."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please... don't let yourself be defeated. 
—That is not your role.

Parting ways with Dream Journey, Orfevre 
strides forward briskly... Before 
realizing it, she had arrived at an 
unfamiliar place.
choice_data_list:
Is it just me, or... is it kind of chilly 
in here?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It must be the wind.
—Excuse me, you two. You lovely ladies...

The person who called out to us was a 
frail-looking elderly woman in light 
clothing. ...She looked terribly cold.

I hurriedly draped a jacket over her for 
the moment. Seeing that, Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Give that to the old woman. —The muffler.

Ah, thank you very much... You two are so 
beautiful and kind...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Pitiful commoner. Consider this the king's 
mercy... There will not be a second time.

Yes, understood. Pardon me... but I have 
one request.

Would you please... share your wishes with 
this old woman? If you do, it will surely 
bring even more warmth.
choice_data_list: I-is that really how it is?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a pain. You deal with them.

Ah...... Your profound love and care for 
the Umamusume... I have truly felt it...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, look at that.

At the spot Orfevre gestured to with her 
chin... lay a dirty Jizo statue, wrapped 
in my jacket and a red muffler.

The next day, when Orfevre showed up on 
the track... her coat seemed even more 
radiant than usual.

Ah...... Your profound love and care for 
the Umamusume... I have truly felt it...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, look at that.

At the spot Orfevre gestured to with her 
chin... lay a dirty Jizo statue, wrapped 
in my jacket and a red muffler.

In the training sessions following that 
day, she displayed remarkable power. 
Almost as if she were possessed by 
something...

Ah...... Your profound love and care for 
the Umamusume... I have truly felt it...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, look at that.

At the spot Orfevre gestured to with her 
chin... lay a dirty Jizo statue, wrapped 
in my jacket and a red muffler.

For some reason, her subjects doubled the 
next day, making Orfevre even more 
haughty... Her good mood continued for 
days to come.
